summary: The candidate adds a closed App token repository-access signature and a generic Actions error-annotation signature to extractSelfFailureSignature, so the maintenance token-mint failure no longer falls through to the job fallback. Unit tests cover the closed key and the sanitization order, and an end-to-end pass test shows one filed issue with the app-token marker and no refile. No defects found.

evidence: ops/self-defects.ts adds the App token repository-access key sentinel-supervisor:maintenance:app-token:repository-access and a generic ##[error] annotation signature that returns the closed job-reported-an-error summary.
tests/repair/self_defects_test.ts checks the app-token key with and without a timestamp and confirms warning and notice annotations still fall back to job:observed.

tests/repair/hosted_self_observation_test.ts runs the production observation pass on the maintenance token-mint annotation and asserts one sanitized filed issue with the app-token marker, no private markers, and no refile on the next pass.
